'''Falpas sauce''' was a type of [[Sauce/Legends|sauce]]. [[Human/Legends|Human]] businessman [[Cristoff]] consumed falpas sauce, which allowed [[Gender/Legends|female]] criminal [[Bink Kitik]] to detect which numbers on his safe keypad he had keyed in and amount of times had touched them.
